arxiv.title: Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module
arxiv.abstract: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.
arxiv.titleZh: 逐层、逐模块地探测 Transformer 表征
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对「该探测 Transformer 哪一层表征」的问题，指出现有做法只沿深度维度研究、把每个 Transformer 块当作原子单元，忽略了模块维度。通过对视觉基础模型与 LLM 进行超过 14.4 万次线性探测评估，发现层与模块应联合选择：最佳层—模块组合相对最终层残差流的增益，明显大于固定残差流时最佳层带来的增益；且各模块的相对表现随层显著变化，说明有用表征无法仅用深度刻画。据此给出两种简单固定策略——视觉用最终层前馈激活（Act@100）、语言用 60% 深度的第二归一化层（LN2@60），在多数评估中优于基线，分别找回最佳层—模块组合增益的 42% 与 86%，且视觉模型的增益随预训练与下游数据迁移难度增大而提升。
arxiv.reason: 表征探测方法学，涉及 LLM 内部机制但与后训练／Agent 主线擦边

arxiv.title: Data Manipulation Attacks Against Machine Learning Integrated Cyber-Physical Systems
arxiv.abstract: There is a well-established body of work demonstrating that individual machine learning (ML) algorithms can be manipulated or deceived. However, in many real-world systems, multiple ML algorithms are composed to enable automated decision-making, particularly in Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). Often such systems use a composition of vision, planning, and other ML models to affect their internal state and ultimate take actions in the physical world. While there is a huge literature on the (in)security of ML algorithms, it is not immediately clear how an attacker might leverage their ability to trick individual learners when attacking the composition as a whole. We develop methods for creating an attack policy (a mapping from state to attack) for a data-manipulating attacker affecting a CPS or other state-machine-based AI compositions. We describe our framework, a basic threat model and corresponding methods for computing an optimal attack policy, as well as planned extensions. The goal of this work-in-progress paper is to stimulate conversation and forge new collaborations regarding the security of compositional learning.
arxiv.titleZh: 针对机器学习集成信息物理系统的数据操纵攻击
arxiv.summaryZh: 单个机器学习模型可被对抗操纵已有大量研究，但视觉、规划等模型组合成的信息物理系统在整体层面如何被攻击仍不清楚。该工作提出将攻击表示为「状态到攻击」的映射，给出数据操纵攻击者影响CPS或其他状态机式AI组合的威胁模型与最优攻击策略计算方法。当前为进展中论文，未报告实证结果，计划后续扩展，旨在推动组合学习安全研究与合作。
arxiv.reason: CPS与组合ML安全，偏离LLM主线且仅为进展稿

arxiv.title: A Stability Analysis of AdamW: Unstable Equilibria and Non-Convergence
arxiv.abstract: AdamW is ubiquitous in deep learning, yet its behavior remains poorly understood. We analyze its dynamics through the lens of dynamical systems and show that AdamW admits an implicit fixed-point objective: its fixed points coincide with the stationary points of a constrained and regularized optimization problem. However, not all of these fixed points are stable under AdamW's dynamics, and stability depends sensitively on curvature, weight decay, and momentum parameters. Even in one-dimensional settings, equilibria may be unstable, and trajectories can exhibit persistent oscillations rather than convergence to them. We further extend the analysis to higher dimensions, deriving sufficient conditions for local stability of the continuous-time dynamics, and propose a convergent modification that preserves AdamW's fixed points. These results clarify what optimization problem AdamW is associated with, when its convergence can be expected, and how its dynamics could inspire more reliable optimizers.
arxiv.titleZh: AdamW 的稳定性分析：不稳定平衡点与不收敛性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 AdamW 广泛使用但收敛行为缺乏理论解释的问题，从动力系统视角分析其隐含的不动点目标：AdamW 的不动点恰好是某个带约束与正则化优化问题的驻点，但并非所有不动点都稳定，稳定性敏感地依赖曲率、权重衰减与动量参数。即使在一维情形下平衡点也可能不稳定，轨迹会出现持续振荡而非收敛到平衡点。工作进一步推广到高维，给出连续时间动力学局部稳定的充分条件，并提出一种保留原不动点的收敛性修正。该结果为判断 AdamW 关联何种优化问题、何时可期望收敛提供理论依据，也指向更可靠的优化器设计。
arxiv.reason: AdamW 动力系统稳定性理论分析，命中优化器方向但偏纯理论

arxiv.title: Boundary Mass in Feature Space as a Label-Budget Diagnostic for Representations
arxiv.abstract: Low-label transfer is often decided by a practical question: after a representation looks useful, how many labels are still needed to learn the downstream boundary? Transferability and probe-quality scores characterize global alignment, likelihood, margins, and calibration. Boundary-near target mass complements these diagnostics by measuring the ambiguous regions where scarce labels are most costly. We propose effective boundary complexity, a label-budget diagnostic for frozen representations and linear probes. It measures mass in a thin strip around the learned boundary and normalizes it by class balance, so dense ambiguous regions and predicted-class imbalance are both counted. We prove that, under a smooth representation map, density change and tangential surface change cancel at first order, leaving boundary-normal stretch or compression as the governing factor. This yields a cached-feature estimator that fits a probe on one split and counts independent held-out features near its boundary. Experiments support the diagnostic at three levels. Controlled transformations match the predicted law across 74 maps with 0.38% median relative error. On real frozen features, normal-direction changes move both measured boundary mass and label demand, while tangent controls preserve the first-order coefficient. A differentiable surrogate reduces measured complexity by 16-36% at matched top-1 utility. Finally, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet experiments support boundary mass as a second-stage diagnostic for near-tied representations. Five-way experiments show strong OvR-interface backbone-ranking agreement (Spearman 0.872), while acquisition experiments show high correlations between initial boundary mass and realized label budgets across three sampling policies (0.779-0.830). Code is available at https://github.com/qqaqq-code/boundary_mass.
arxiv.titleZh: 特征空间中的边界质量作为表征的标签预算诊断指标
arxiv.summaryZh: 用冻结表征做低标签迁移时，现有迁移性与探针质量指标只刻画全局对齐、似然与校准，无法回答「还需要多少标签才能学出下游边界」。为此提出有效边界复杂度:在学习到的线性边界周围薄带内统计目标特征的密度，并按类别平衡归一化，同时计入模糊区密度与预测类别不均衡;理论证明在光滑表征映射下一阶的密度变化与切向面积变化相互抵消，主导因素只剩边界法向的拉伸或压缩，由此得到一个缓存特征估计器——在一个划分上拟合探针、在独立留出特征上统计近边界质量。74 组合成映射上中位相对误差 0.38%，真实冻结特征上法向扰动同时改变边界质量与标签需求，可微替代目标在同等 top-1 效用下把复杂度降低 16–36%,CIFAR-100 与 Tiny-ImageNet 上五路实验的骨干排序 Spearman 相关达 0.872，初始边界质量与三种采样策略下的实际标签预算相关为 0.779–0.830。该指标可作为近似并列表征的第二阶段诊断工具。
arxiv.reason: 表征评测新诊断指标，与LLM后训练/Agent仅间接相关

arxiv.title: Hydra: Towards Transferable Multi-Task Learning on Temporal Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Real-world evolving networks are naturally modeled as temporal graphs (TGs), where capturing temporal dynamics is essential for predicting future graph properties that support downstream decision-making. Existing temporal graph methods have been developed primarily for single-task prediction, and little is known about their generalization across tasks or transfer to unseen networks. This leaves the challenge of multi-task graph property prediction in TGs largely open. We address this challenge by introducing Hydra, a novel architecture that integrates local connectivity features from temporal GNNs with a spectral learning module that captures global connectivity patterns. This design enables joint learning of local and global information under a multi-task objective. In multi-task classification, Hydra achieves an 8.9% relative gain in AUC over the strongest competitor. In multi-task regression, Hydra achieves competitive results in all three tasks, while obtaining the best results in two tasks with a 8.2% relative gain in MAE compared to the strongest baseline. Moreover, Hydra delivers these gains with a 22% reduction in training time compared to temporal transfer models. These results provide the first systematic evidence that multi-task transferable learning on temporal graphs is effective. By delivering consistent top-ranked performance, Hydra highlights multi-task training on temporal graphs as a promising direction toward adaptable foundation models for temporal graphs.
arxiv.titleZh: Hydra:面向时序图的可迁移多任务学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 时序图方法多针对单任务预测，跨任务泛化与迁移到未见网络的能力尚不清楚，时序图上的多任务图属性预测仍是开放问题。Hydra 将时序 GNN 提取的局部连接特征与捕获全局连接模式的谱学习模块结合，在多任务目标下联合学习局部与全局信息。多任务分类中 AUC 相对最强基线提升 8.9%;多任务回归中三项任务均具竞争力，其中两项最佳，MAE 相对提升 8.2%，训练时间比时序迁移模型减少 22%。结果首次系统证明时序图多任务可迁移学习有效，指向可适配的时序图基础模型。
arxiv.reason: 时序图多任务学习，与 LLM/Agent 画像无交集

arxiv.title: Detecting Common Golfing Faults Using AI and Video-Derived Biomechanical Features
arxiv.abstract: Understanding how an athlete moves can improve both technique and safety, yet outside the laboratory technique is still assessed by eye. We present a pipeline that detects named golf swing faults from ordinary video, without markers or calibration. Instead of learning end to end, it tracks body pose and the clubhead in a body-centered frame, and classifies the biomechanical quantities a coach would measure, such as the height of the clubhead above the swing plane, with shallow boosted trees. We demonstrate the approach on two common faults, coming over-the-top (OTT) and early-extension (EE). On 160 swings and 143 swings from public sources it detects OTT and EE with a cross-validated ROC-AUC of 0.975 and 0.911 respectively. Because every feature is a biomechanical quantity a coach already uses, measured at a known phase of the downswing, each decision can be traced to the signals and the moments of the swing that drove it. The signals the model relies on most are the same ones a coach checks when diagnosing these faults. The pipeline processes phone video on a consumer laptop in seconds, so it could feasibly be developed into an app for golfers of all abilities and extended to other sports in which technique is judged against a biomechanical reference.
arxiv.titleZh: 结合 AI 与视频衍生的生物力学特征检测常见高尔夫挥杆失误
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对实验室之外的技术动作仍靠肉眼评估的问题，提出一套无需标记点与相机标定的普通视频分析流程：先跟踪人体姿态与杆头位置并统一到以身体为中心的坐标系，再用浅层提升树对教练常用的生物力学量（如杆头相对挥杆平面的高度）进行分类。在公开来源的 160 次与 143 次挥杆上，对 over-the-top 与 early-extension 两类失误的交叉验证 ROC-AUC 分别为 0.975 与 0.911，且每项特征对应下杆特定阶段的已知量，判定可追溯。整套流程可在消费级笔记本上数秒内处理手机视频，为球手技术自检与其他以生物力学为参照的运动项目提供了可行路径。
arxiv.reason: 体育动作识别垂直应用，与 LLM／Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: ConvLUT: Rethinking Convolutional Architectures for Ultra-Low-Latency LUT-Based Inference
arxiv.abstract: Lookup-table (LUT)-based neural networks (NNs) offer a compelling path to ultra-low-latency inference on FPGAs. However, existing LUT-based neural networks have largely been restricted to MLP-style topologies, leaving structured vision and audio tasks underexplored. We present ConvLUT, a family of fully unrolled LUT-mappable convolutional architectures targeting the MLPerf Tiny benchmarks. It is comprised of a standard convolutional model built around a hierarchical tree of LUTs and a depthwise separable model following the MobileNet design philosophy. These architectures are enabled by four key contributions: a unified LUT-based convolutional framework supporting standard, depthwise, and pointwise convolutions under explicit fan-in constraints; a LUT-tree that addresses the $k^2c$ receptive field dimensionality bottleneck; a channel-partitioned LUT pooling layer that replaces conventional spatial pooling; and a hardware-aware iterative pruning strategy for stable convergence at scale. Evaluated on CIFAR-10, Visual Wake Words, and Keyword Spotting, ConvLUT achieves competitive accuracy with fully unrolled inference latencies below $\sim 50$ ns. On CIFAR-10 it reaches at least a $8844\times$ latency reduction over non-logic-based prior implementations, and outperforms existing MLP-style LUT-based models on the same task by at least $20$ pp in test accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: ConvLUT：重新思考面向超低延迟 LUT 推理的卷积架构
arxiv.summaryZh: 基于查找表（LUT）的神经网络能在 FPGA 上实现超低延迟推理，但此前多局限于 MLP 结构，难以覆盖视觉与音频任务。ConvLUT 面向 MLPerf Tiny，构建可完全展开并映射到 LUT 的卷积架构：统一的 LUT 卷积框架支持标准、深度可分离与逐点卷积，并施加显式扇入约束；LUT 树缓解 k²c 感受野瓶颈；通道分区 LUT 池化替代空间池化；硬件感知迭代剪枝保证大规模收敛。在 CIFAR-10、Visual Wake Words 与关键词识别上精度有竞争力，完全展开推理延迟低于约 50 ns；CIFAR-10 上较非逻辑实现降低至少 8844 倍延迟，测试精度超同类 MLP 式 LUT 模型至少 20 个百分点。
arxiv.reason: FPGA LUT 硬件推理架构，属硬件/嵌入式方向，与 LLM 无关

arxiv.title: Data-informed Adaptation of Foundation Models for Causal Effect Estimation
arxiv.abstract: Due to the fundamental problem of causal inference -- the impossibility of observing counterfactual outcomes -- there is always a gap between the training goal (outcome, propensity) and the inference target (CATE, ATE). Traditional causal effect estimation revolves around setting assumptions, selecting identification strategies, and choosing causal estimators, while more recently, Causal Foundation Models (CFMs), built on Prior-Data-Fitted Networks (PFNs), ease this process by pretraining on massive synthetic prior datasets. Despite their success, such amortization makes causal inference less transparent, obscuring which assumptions the model implicitly relies on for a given dataset. The high diversity of real-world data-generating processes (DGPs) and Structural Causal Models (SCMs) makes it hard to know, a priori, which causal inference strategy is compatible with a given dataset. In this work, we focus on this compatibility between an observational dataset and method-specific assumptions, and find that geometric characteristics of data embeddings -- specifically, the variogram -- provide a useful signal of whether a given causal estimation strategy is appropriate. We develop MoE-Learner, a mixture-of-causal-experts framework that embeds a dataset under multiple assumption-specific views and uses the variogram as a counterfactual-free router to assess each expert's validity. Rather than eliminating causal assumptions, this shifts their validation from a fixed, a priori choice to a criterion that can be checked directly from data geometry. MoE-Learner achieves the best average rank on benchmark datasets (IHDP, ACIC, Lalonde). Being orthogonal to (causal) foundation models, our method builds a bridge from data characteristics to causal estimation strategy rather than proposing another CFM.
arxiv.titleZh: 数据知情的基础模型适配用于因果效应估计
arxiv.summaryZh: 观测数据与因果估计方法所依赖的假设常常不匹配，而基于PFN预训练的因果基础模型把假设隐式地摊销进网络，难以判断对给定数据集是否适用。工作提出用数据嵌入的几何特征——变差函数（variogram）——作为无需反事实的路由信号，构建MoE-Learner：在多个假设特定视角下嵌入同一数据集，由混合因果专家依据该信号评估各专家有效性，把假设校验从先验固定选择转为可据数据几何检验的准则。在IHDP、ACIC、Lalonde基准上取得最优平均排名，且与因果基础模型正交，可视为从数据特征到因果估计策略的桥接。
arxiv.reason: 因果推断方法学，仅在基础模型与PFN概念上与LLM方向擦边

arxiv.title: Does Merge Form a Hopf Algebra? Coproducts, Traces, and the Prospects of Algebraic Minimalism
arxiv.abstract: Marcolli, Chomsky, and Berwick (2025; henceforth MCB) formulate the Merge operation of Minimalism on a Hopf algebra of Connes-Kreimer type, and claim that language and physics obey the same algebraic structure. This paper separates their program into the working hypothesis H, that Merge on workspaces can be described as a Hopf algebra, and the claim P placed on top of it, that language and physics obey the same principle, and examines the validity of H. MCB employs two coproducts in formulating Merge, corresponding to two different translations of movement (Internal Merge): $Δ_d$, which deletes the lower copy, and $Δ_c$, which leaves a trace. MCB uses the former in syntax and the latter at the syntax-semantics interface, but $Δ_d$ is not coassociative, and $Δ_c$ is not connected under the gradings MCB gives and, moreover, not coassociative as long as the labels of traces are retained. Consequently, MCB's algebra is not a Hopf algebra, and the Birkhoff factorization is not a consequence of the Hopf-algebra theorem but of a weaker statement that requires neither coassociativity nor connectedness. There are four ways to recover a Hopf algebra, but none of them can distinguish different traces, and hence none is compatible with Heim-Kratzer-style formal semantics, which reads traces as indexed variables. Thus H does not hold at present, and under the current formulation, making Minimalism a Hopf algebra and preserving its connection with formal semantics are mutually exclusive. Finally, we indicate three directions in which algebraic Minimalism may proceed.
arxiv.titleZh: Merge 构成 Hopf 代数吗?余积、迹与代数极小主义的前景
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Marcolli、Chomsky 与 Berwick 把最简方案的 Merge 建立在 Connes-Kreimer 型 Hopf 代数上、并宣称语言与物理共享同一代数结构的纲领，将其拆为工作假设 H 与更强主张 P，只检验 H。用于 Internal Merge 的两种余积中，删去下层拷贝的 Δ_d 不余结合，保留语迹的 Δ_c 在给定分次下不连通、保留语迹标签时也不余结合，故该代数并非 Hopf 代数，Birkhoff 分解实由更弱命题推出。四条修复路径都无法区分不同语迹，与 Heim-Kratzer 式形式语义不相容，H 目前不成立。
arxiv.reason: 形式语言学与 Hopf 代数公理化，与 LLM 后训练 / Agent 无关

arxiv.title: JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: The performance of language agents depends jointly on model weights and the harness. Optimizing either alone can be constrained by the other component, limiting overall performance gains. Our analysis of naive alternating training reveals progressive incompatibility between the model and harness, which increasingly interferes with task execution and may also undermine model training, leading to performance degradation. To coordinate the evolution of models and harnesses, we introduce JoMoHa, to our knowledge the first framework to jointly train an executable harness generation policy and a task execution policy through reinforcement learning. JoMoHa outperforms the evaluated weight-only and harness-only baselines and achieves the highest success rates among the evaluated methods on ALFWorld, WebShop, and DBBench, averaging 70.3% and reaching 97.0% on ALFWorld. By learning both task execution and runtime improvement from its own generated trajectories, JoMoHa performs recursive self-improvement (RSI).
arxiv.titleZh: JoMoHa：模型与harness的强化学习联合优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言Agent的表现同时取决于模型权重与harness，单独优化任一方都会被另一方约束；对朴素交替训练的观察显示，模型与harness会逐步变得互不兼容，进而干扰任务执行，甚至损害模型训练。JoMoHa用强化学习同时训练可执行的harness生成策略与任务执行策略，让二者协同演化，并从自身生成的轨迹中同时学习任务执行与运行时改进，形成递归自我改进。在ALFWorld、WebShop、DBBench上，该方法平均成功率达70.3%，其中ALFWorld达97.0%，优于仅优化权重与仅优化harness的基线。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL中模型与harness联合优化，机制新颖且命中Agent方向

arxiv.title: TID System for Speech-COSER Challenge 2026: ASR Track
arxiv.abstract: We describe the system submitted by Telefónica Innovación Digital to the Speech-COSER Challenge 2026, which features spontaneous speech from elderly speakers recorded in rural Spain. For ASR, we perform CTC-based pseudo-forced alignment scores audio-text match quality to guide a two-stage LoRA curriculum, followed by post-hoc magnitude pruning of the LoRA matrices to enhance generalization. An ensemble of seven systems combined via ROVER achieves 36.25\% unnormalized and 22.17\% normalized WER.
arxiv.titleZh: TID 系统：Speech-COSER Challenge 2026 ASR 赛道
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对西班牙农村老年说话人的自发语音识别，构建基于 CTC 伪强制对齐的打分机制，用来衡量音频与文本的匹配质量，并据此安排两阶段 LoRA 课程学习；训练后对 LoRA 矩阵做幅度剪枝，以提升泛化能力。最终将七个系统通过 ROVER 融合，得到 36.25% 未归一化与 22.17% 归一化 WER。工作属于特定口音与老年群体的语音识别工程优化，偏竞赛系统报告。
arxiv.reason: 语音识别竞赛系统，属低分语音应用方向

arxiv.title: Regret without Optimal-Arm Feedback under Reward-Dependent Delays
arxiv.abstract: We study stochastic bandits with reward-dependent delays, possibly infinite, whose reports omit the originating round. For each $c\in[0,1)$, Balanced Historical Optimism (BHO) has a delay term controlled by the largest suboptimal-arm quantile at level $1-cΔ_i$, without requiring optimal-arm reports. Lower bounds give an inverse-square slack cost in the logarithmic statistical regime and linear minimax regret at $c=1$. A family with growing $K$ forces worst-case regret $Ω(G\log K)$ for every learner, where $G=\max_iΔ_i h_i$ is the largest gap-weighted suboptimal cutoff. Pending-triggered balance preserves BHO's weighted-cutoff bound for $c<1$ and attains the historical-greedy exploration coefficient with deterministic rewards, a unique optimum and fixed bounded delays. Gap-weighted comparisons and experiments show when shared waiting helps and what balanced exploration costs.
arxiv.comment: 45 pages, 3 figures. Code and data are included as ancillary files
arxiv.titleZh: 奖励依赖延迟下无需最优臂反馈的遗憾分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究随机 bandit 中延迟与奖励相关、可能无限、且回报不携带来源轮次信息的反馈设定。提出 Balanced Historical Optimism（BHO）：对每个 c∈[0,1)，其延迟项由次优臂在 1-cΔ_i 分位上的最大分位数控制，从而无需最优臂的回报即可给出遗憾界；下界表明，在对数统计区间内需付出平方反比的松弛代价，而 c=1 时 minimax 遗憾为线性。构造随臂数 K 增长的一族实例，证明任何学习器的遗憾下界为 Ω(G log K)，其中 G 为以间隙加权的最大次优截断。pending-triggered balance 变体在 c<1 时保持 BHO 的加权截断界，并在确定性奖励、唯一最优臂与固定有界延迟下达到历史贪心探索的系数；实验比较了共享等待何时有益，以及平衡探索的代价。
arxiv.reason: 纯 bandit 遗憾理论，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: Learning through Capacity Awareness to Minimize Hospital Readmissions
arxiv.abstract: Predictive algorithms are increasingly used to guide hospital discharge decisions, yet these models can exhibit censoring bias for vulnerable patients due to insufficient historical data or past discharge decisions. When biased readmission risk predictors are used to inform discharges, the training data generated by discharge decisions may perpetuate similar biases when predictors are re-trained, leading to a vicious cycle. We extend a queueing-based Markov decision process for hospital discharge to incorporate periodically retrained readmission risk predictors. Our key insight is that cost-optimal, "capacity-aware" operational decision policies can naturally diversify the lengths of stay at which patient outcomes are observed, enabling consistent estimation of readmission risk without explicit fairness constraints. We prove that repeated retraining under discharge-up-to policies converges to unbiased risk estimates under well-specification. In synthetic experiments and calibrated simulations based on patient-level data from a partner hospital, we find that where commonly used threshold-on-risk policies can remain persistently biased, discharge-up-to policies reduce learning error over status quo decision policies (such as thresholding on risk) by 24%-25%. These improvements to estimation also mitigate some forms of bias, reducing readmission cost disparities (adjusted for baseline risk differences between demographic groups) by 38%-63%. Our results demonstrate how capacity-aware decision policies can improve both predictive performance and fairness by addressing censoring bias.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过容量感知学习以最小化医院再入院
arxiv.summaryZh: 医院出院决策所依赖的再入院风险预测器，会因历史数据不足和既往出院决策产生截尾偏差；这些决策生成的数据在预测器反复重训练时又会让偏差自我强化。研究把周期性重训练的再入院风险预测器嵌入基于排队论的出院马尔可夫决策过程，发现成本最优的“容量感知”策略会自然分散患者结局被观测到的住院时长，从而无需显式公平约束即可一致地估计再入院风险，并证明在模型正确设定下，discharge-up-to 策略的反复重训练收敛到无偏估计。基于合作医院患者个体数据校准的模拟显示，相比常用的风险阈值策略，该方法将学习误差降低 24%–25%，并把按人群基线风险调整后的再入院成本差异缩小 38%–63%，说明容量感知决策可同时改善预测性能与公平性。
arxiv.reason: 医疗出院决策与公平性建模，与LLM关注方向无关

arxiv.title: THEATRON: A Benchmark for Evaluating Persona Persistence in Long-Horizon LLM Decision-Making
arxiv.abstract: Existing evaluations often test persona expression rather than whether persona information persists in extended decision-making. We introduce THEATRON, a controlled benchmark that uses financial replay to evaluate persona persistence in long-horizon sequential decision-making. In these environments, models conditioned on fixed behavioral-finance personas observe shared daily market evidence and trajectory-specific account-state feedback and make sequential decisions over multi-month trajectories. We evaluate Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Chain-of-Thought persona injection across four LLMs, using cumulative-return and action trajectories to diagnose within-persona stability, cross-persona separability, and action collapse. Persona conditioning produces systematic behavioral shifts beyond a no-persona baseline, and persona-level separation generally exceeds the variation induced by semantically equivalent descriptions. Nevertheless, these shifts do not reliably form coherent persona-specific policies: apparently stable separation can arise from stereotyped action collapse, while diverse policies can exhibit noisy trajectory switching. These findings expose a gap between observable persona-induced behavior and persistent, context-sensitive persona-conditioned decision policies. Code and benchmark data are publicly available at: https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron
arxiv.titleZh: THEATRON：评估长时程 LLM 决策中人格持久性的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有评测多检验人格表达，而非人格信息能否在长时程决策中持续生效。THEATRON 用金融回放构建受控基准：模型被给定行为金融人格，在多个月的共享每日市场证据与轨迹相关的账户状态反馈下做序列决策，并以零样本、单样本与思维链三种人格注入方式测试四个 LLM，用累计收益与动作轨迹诊断人格内稳定性、跨人格可分性与动作坍缩。结果显示人格条件带来超越无人格基线的系统性行为偏移，且人格间差异通常大于语义等价描述造成的波动，但这些偏移未必形成连贯的人格特定策略——稳定分离可能源于刻板化动作坍缩，策略多样也可能表现为噪声式轨迹切换。该基准揭示了可观测人格行为与持久、情境敏感的人格条件决策策略之间的差距，适用于 LLM 长时程决策与人格一致性的评测研究。
arxiv.reason: LLM 长时程决策评测新基准，属评测方法学，但人格设定偏窄

arxiv.title: MicroSim: Contrastive Graph Neural Networks for Binary Code Similarity Detection
arxiv.abstract: We present MicroSim, a system for binary code similarity detection that represents each function as a graph built from IDA Pro Hex-Rays microcode and compares such graphs with a contrastive Siamese graph neural network (GNN). We evaluate on the TREX cross-optimization benchmark, a corpus of 849,072 function-level microcode graphs spanning optimization levels -O0 through -O3, under a strict class-disjoint split in which no function key is shared between train and test. Under this protocol, MicroSim reaches 0.9972 area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) and 0.9762 Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), outperforming Gemini (0.9332 ROC-AUC), SAFE (0.9752), and jTrans (0.9740) retrained on the same split, as well as a structure-free Bag-of-Words (BoW) baseline (0.9484). We analyze the gap between pair classification and ranked retrieval in graph transformers, showing that Cross-domain Similarity Local Scaling (CSLS) under unified tie-resolved evaluation raises GraphGPS mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 0.2542 to 0.2559 (R@1 = 0.1639, R@10 = 0.4561), strictly satisfying the theoretical MRR upper bound. Finally, over 5 seeds with equal compute, the pairwise cosine-embedding loss attains a slightly higher ROC-AUC (Δ = -0.0256, 95% confidence interval [-0.3282, +0.2770]), whereas the supervised-contrastive information noise-contrastive estimation (InfoNCE) loss is significantly better on thresholded classification and ranked retrieval.
arxiv.titleZh: MicroSim：面向二进制代码相似性检测的对比图神经网络
arxiv.summaryZh: 二进制代码相似性检测在跨优化级别场景下仍易受编译优化干扰。MicroSim 将每个函数表示为基于 IDA Pro Hex-Rays 微码构建的图，并用对比式孪生图神经网络比较图结构；在 TREX 跨优化基准（849072 个函数级微码图，-O0 至 -O3，严格类不相交划分）上取得 0.9972 ROC-AUC 与 0.9762 MCC，高于同划分重训的 Gemini（0.9332）、SAFE（0.9752）、jTrans（0.9740）及无结构的 BoW 基线（0.9484）。工作进一步分析图 Transformer 在配对分类与排序检索间的差距，并比较余弦嵌入损失与 InfoNCE 损失在分类和检索上的表现差异，可用于二进制分析、漏洞检索与供应链安全场景。
arxiv.reason: 二进制相似性检测，非 LLM 方向，仅与代码智能弱相关

arxiv.title: One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering for Distributed Non-IID Biomedical Data Analysis
arxiv.abstract: In multi-institutional biomedical data analysis, comprehensive disease profiles are often fragmented across different data silos. Furthermore, local data distributions typically exhibit varying levels of granularity or even complex nested structures. Although Hierarchical Clustering (HC) is a powerful tool for exploring such data topologies, its cumbersome recursive process incurs prohibitive computational overhead and renders it highly susceptible to privacy leakage. This paper, therefore, introduces an efficient one-shot hierarchical FC framework that performs client-end (institutions) distribution exploration and server-end distribution aggregation through one-way prototype-level communication from clients to the server. Although the designed one-shot prototype transmission guarantees minimal computational overhead and mitigates privacy risks, it inevitably incurs information loss. To counteract this, a multi-granular competitive learning mechanism is proposed on the server to fuse the clusterlets, effectively maximizing the retention and mining of global distribution topologies under limited, one-way communication constraints. It turns out that the complex cluster distributions across clients can be efficiently explored, and extensive experiments comparing state-of-the-art methods on public datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework in balancing robust clustering, privacy preservation, and computational efficiency.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向分布式非独立同分布生物医学数据分析的一次性分层联邦聚类
arxiv.summaryZh: 多机构生物医学数据常被分散在各自的数据孤岛中，且本地分布具有不同粒度乃至嵌套结构；分层聚类虽适合探索这类拓扑，但递归过程计算开销大、隐私风险高。为此提出一次性分层联邦聚类框架：客户端在本地做分布探索，仅通过单向的 prototype 级通信向服务器上传原型，由服务器端聚合分布；针对单向通信必然带来的信息损失，服务器端引入多粒度竞争学习机制融合小簇，以在受限通信下最大限度保留并挖掘全局分布拓扑。在公开数据集上与现有方法对比的实验表明，该框架在聚类稳健性、隐私保护与计算效率之间取得了更优平衡。
arxiv.reason: 联邦分层聚类用于生物医学数据，与 LLM 关注方向无关

arxiv.title: Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M: One Small Embedder for Tajik, Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz
arxiv.abstract: The small open embedder EmbeddingGemma-300M, used as released, finds the right passage first for only 51.7% to 60.8% of Belebele questions in Tajik, Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz. We present Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M, one model for all four languages. It is our Tajik fine-tune of EmbeddingGemma-300M, trained for one more epoch on 279,904 pairs: questions in Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz that our own language model wrote about source passages, a Tajik refresher, and English and Russian replay. On Belebele, recall@1 rises by 14.4 to 26.0 points in each language, to between 75.2% and 77.7%. Against single-language models trained with the same settings, the one model stays within 2.8 points at recall@1 in Kazakh, Uzbek and Tajik, with overlapping recall@10 intervals, though it also had more training. It keeps the Tajik law recall@10 of its starting point (92.2 against 92.4) but loses 4.4 points of law recall@1. A model trained on one of these languages also improves the others on Belebele, but less than training on them. The model still trails the 560M XLM-RoBERTa embedders on Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz Belebele: the better of multilingual-e5-large-instruct and BGE-M3, used as released, is 9.4 to 10.2 points ahead at recall@1. Our scores of those released models agree with the published MTEB results within 2.4 points. Russian and English recall@1 fall by 3.0 and 4.2 points.
arxiv.comment: 12 pages, 6 tables, 2 figures. Technical report. Model: https://huggingface.co/Tohirju/Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M
arxiv.titleZh: Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M:一个覆盖塔吉克语、哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和吉尔吉斯语的小型嵌入模型
arxiv.summaryZh: EmbeddingGemma-300M按发布原样使用，在塔吉克语、哈萨克语、乌兹别克语、吉尔吉斯语上recall@1仅51.7%–60.8%，该工作用单个模型统一覆盖这四种语言。它以自家语言模型围绕源段落生成四语问题，再加入塔吉克语复训数据与英语、俄语replay，合计279,904对，继续训练一个epoch。在Belebele上，各语言recall@1提升14.4–26.0点至75.2%–77.7%，与同设置单语模型相差不超过2.8点;塔吉克语法条recall@10保持92.2，但recall@1下降4.4点;哈萨克语、乌兹别克语、吉尔吉斯语上，该模型仍落后XLM-R 560M嵌入模型9.4–10.2点。
